title: ci(mcp): a diff confined to packages/mcp runs the Console SKILL.md mirror pin
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_

Fixes #31017

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：在 `@objectstack/mcp` 自己的测试里加了一条“控制台下载版 SKILL.md 与服务端版逐字节一致”的钉子，并把这条跨包读取登记到 CI 的四处台账（跨包输入表、turbo 哈希、`crosspkg` 过滤行、过滤对账自检）。
- **为什么改**：只改 MCP 服务端 SKILL.md 渲染的 PR 不会启动 Test UI，原来唯一的漂移钉子就不跑，控制台“下载技能”可能再次教给智能体一个服务端会拒绝的调用（#30865 的事故形态）。
- **风险与回滚**：不改任何发布产物（已构建 dist 中零命中），只多一条测试和四行登记；mcp 的测试编译根目录放宽到仓库根，严格度不变。回滚即整体 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.test.ts`（新 describe）、`.github/workflows/ci.yml`（`crosspkg` 新增一行及注释）、`packages/mcp/tsconfig.test.json`（`rootDir` 放宽及注释改写）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/skill-md.test.ts`，预期 16 个用例全过；把 `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 里的 `DELETE_RECORDS_MAX_PER_CALL` 临时改成 250 再跑，预期 5 个“renders the served text”用例变红。
- **需要你做的**：本 PR 触及 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`（Tier H 受管面），需要你批准（APPROVED review）后由席位落地。

## What changes

A pull request that edits only `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` matches neither the `ui` nor the `ui_consumers` filter, so Test UI never started and the Console pin `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.test.ts` (PR #31015) never ran on it, on the PR or in the queue. This PR takes the card's second fix: an equivalent pin on the `packages/mcp` side that Test Core runs.

- `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe('renderSkillMarkdown is mirrored by the Console download')` imports the Console mirror from source and asserts the identity constants and five renders byte-identical, the same table the Console half uses.
- `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`: `@objectstack/mcp` declares `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts`.
- `turbo.json`: `@objectstack/mcp#test` hashes that file (`$TURBO_ROOT$/...`).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: one `crosspkg` row for that file, with a comment naming the Console pin and #30865. No job, `if:` or timeout changes.
- `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`: the pre-#10015 rollback battery records the new member by name (21 to 22), the way every earlier single-file entry was recorded.
- `packages/mcp/tsconfig.test.json`: `rootDir` widens to `../..` (the shape `packages/cli` and `packages/client` use), and the paragraph that said it needed no widening is rewritten. Without it the import is 1 x TS6059. Strictness is untouched; the ledger still holds the same 53 errors in 6 files.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts` (round 2, header comment only, no code): names both readers, the Console pin and `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.test.ts`, and states the rule that this file stays import-free (or every import must resolve from mcp's test program), because mcp's `tsconfig.test.json` program now compiles it (#31017).

### Why this fix and not the `ui` filter row

- The filter row covers one file. The default render also reads `DELETE_RECORDS_MAX_PER_CALL` from `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`. That file is the same drift one import away, and it had 30 commits on `main` from 2026-09-07 to `5f00374492` (`skill-md.ts` had 13). Covering it with a `ui` row would start the whole ui lane on most MCP pull requests. The mcp-side pin runs on every `packages/mcp` change, because `core` already starts Test Core and `turbo ls --affected` already selects `@objectstack/mcp`.
- The `ui` output starts Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build UI Deps, Build & E2E UI and all 16 Test UI shards, not only Test UI. In the same window, 4 of the 13 `skill-md.ts` commits touched no ui path and no ui-consumed package, so they would have started that lane only for this.
- The price of this fix: a diff confined to the Console mirror now also starts Test Core, and `--union-into` adds `@objectstack/mcp`. The mirror has 3 commits on `main` since the `ui/` import.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `8e90ef14f5`: Test Files 60 passed (60), Tests 768 passed (768).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp run typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck: OK ... 6 file(s) / 53 error(s) / 8 pinned signature(s) held`.
- Ablation, two legs, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the blob restored and its hash compared to `HEAD`:
  - a drift in `skill-md.ts`, where the render's text gains ` (DRIFT)`: 5 failed | 11 passed;
  - `DELETE_RECORDS_MAX_PER_CALL` changed from 200 to 250 in `mcp-http-tools.ts`: 5 failed | 11 passed.
  - After restoring: 16 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- The Console half of the pin stays. It is the one that runs when the mirror changes on a ui-only diff, and the selector already runs it on every Test UI run as an always-on file (it reaches outside `apps/console`).
- The Console still cannot import `@objectstack/mcp` (it is not browser-safe), so the mirror stays a copy. This PR adds a second guard and does not remove the copy.
- Changeset: `skip-changeset`. `@objectstack/mcp`'s `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp build`, the new describe title and the mirror's path have 0 hits in `dist/`, against a positive control (`renderSkillMarkdown`, 4 files). The other files are CI and root config.
